about: Hi! I'm Sebastián Mena, a passionate software engineer with the soul of a designer and a creative mindset. I blend logic, art, and technology to build digital solutions that not only work flawlessly but also look and feel amazing. With over 9 years of experience, I’ve developed projects ranging from intuitive interface design to robust web systems, working comfortably on both the front-end and back-end. I’m fluent in languages like JavaScript, React JS, HTML, CSS, PHP, and Python, optimizing code and solving complex problems efficiently. I also have a strong visual side—I love crafting eye-catching interfaces and editing visual content using tools like Adobe Photoshop, XD, and Premiere. My goal is always to ensure that every project has a clear, functional, and well-thought-out identity.
